name: Outdoor wedding
required: rain relocation and confirmed lightning refuge
rules: Ceremony and reception use the same guest group in different time phases; do not double-count guests, but retain staff and overlaps.
Central aisle target1.8m plus outer cross access; chair-row/gangway rules depend on local adopted code, not this dimension alone.
Photo positions tested at ceremony/portrait times, using actual solar model and photographer preference; reflected glare/trees also matter.
Catering heat/cooking is separate from dining marquee; no generic kitchen/fire approval.
Rain option: approved covered reception layout; severe-weather option: capacity-confirmed building/vehicle plan or early cancellation.
At2000/10000, use multiple reception/ceremony districts with separate services, not one giant stretched marquee.
adjacency: photo zone→away from circulation and water edge

special.ceremony_seats_total: G, including substituted wheelchair spaces; companion seats counted inside G

values_status: All dimensions/ratios/quantities/orientation in this segment are assumptions unless the shared rule supplies a scoped verified_reference

cases.N_status: assumption until staffing/crew and actual concurrent occupancy entered
cases.area_status: assumption; excludes service/queue/egress and does not set code occupant load
cases.site_area_status: rough land-search allowance only; physical layout/anchors/stages/tailgate/exit dispersal require actual area calculation
cases.additional_food_handwash: one per cooking/catering operation provisional; health authority determines quantity
cases.egress_status: NEEDS AUTHORITY REVIEW: based on declared N, not code design load; distribution/travel/downstream/clearance time unverified
cases.wheelchair_status: proposal; fixed-seat ADA table used as inclusion reference for seated cases, scope and integrated layouts need review; standing2% is an assumption
cases.chairs_counts: Two separate chair sets: each phase has regular chairs + wheelchair spaces = G; guests are not double-counted; companion chairs included.
cases.power_status: illustrative listed-part loads only; food refrigeration/cooking/large audio/etc not supplied; no equipment selection approval
cases.rain_covered_capacity: each covered layout separately checked; do not imply enough roofs from counts
